tax.name: Sales tax
tax.note: Prices exclude sales tax. Where it applies, tax is worked out from your billing address and shown on the invoice.

strongAuth.title: Confirm payment
strongAuth.body: Pay {amount} to {company} with the card on file.
strongAuth.rule: No extra step by default; the card issuer can still ask for one on a risky payment.

recurring.title: Agree to automatic top-ups
recurring.body: {company} will charge your card {amount} each time your balance drops below the threshold you set, up to your monthly cap. Turn this off at any time in Top-ups.
recurring.checkbox: I agree to automatic charges on these terms.

autoRenewal.title: Your plan renews automatically
autoRenewal.body: {plan} renews every month on {date} at {price} plus any applicable tax until you cancel. Cancel any time in Plan; you keep access until the end of the paid period. We'll email you before any price change.
